title: Toll Adjustment Audit Module
subtitle: Backend Design Document
author: Engineering

overview.problemStatement: Operators need a reliable way to upload toll transaction files, normalize inconsistent headers, and audit adjustment transactions against expected business rules.
assumptions: Input files are CSV/XLSX with a single header row.
Column aliases may differ by bank or plaza but map to a fixed canonical schema.
Audit runs are idempotent per uploaded dataset.

tables.name: audit_datasets
tables.purpose: One row per uploaded file / audit batch.

tables.name: audit_transactions
tables.purpose: Normalized toll transactions belonging to a dataset.

apis.purpose: Upload a toll file and create a dataset for processing
Fetch dataset status and summary counts
Re-run audit rules on an existing dataset

coreFlows.name: Upload and audit
coreFlows.summary: End-to-end path from file upload to completed audit.
steps: Service stores raw file and creates audit_datasets row (PENDING)
Parser normalizes headers using column aliases
Audit rules run; dataset status becomes COMPLETED or FAILED

coreLogic.title: Header normalization
coreLogic.description: Incoming column names are mapped through aliases to a canonical schema. Unknown required columns fail the dataset early instead of silently dropping data.

coreLogic.title: Adjustment detection
coreLogic.description: Adjustment transactions are identified by txn type / remarks patterns. Matching logic must remain consistent across banks so audits stay comparable.

validationRules: File type must be CSV or XLSX
Required canonical columns must resolve after alias mapping
Amount must be a finite number
Duplicate txn_id within the same dataset is rejected
edgeCases: Empty file or header-only file → mark dataset FAILED with clear error
Partial alias match (some required columns missing) → fail before insert
Reprocess on COMPLETED dataset replaces derived audit flags, not raw rows
Concurrent uploads of the same file name are allowed; datasets remain independent
